title: A slow period in Los Angeles and work at Gene Norman's club
summary: After Australia she stayed in Los Angeles through a quiet stretch, working now and then at a big club that Gene Norman bought and renamed.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well listen, that's right, there was that - you came back to L. A. - after Australia you came back here, didn't you?
And stayed here. And that's when you had a bit of a slow period, I believe, because I
